register_route.description: Internal. Clone and restore set this to false when another instance already serves the host name, so a copy does not take over its route.

admin_password.title: Administrator password
admin_password.description: Password of the PAM user root (login root@pam). Required for the first configuration; an empty value keeps the current password.

options.title: First configuration options
options.description: Interface and system options. Can be changed at any time; omit to keep the stored values.

tls_import.title: Use the Traefik certificate
tls_import.description: Install the certificate Traefik serves for the host name in the Certificates page of Proxmox Datacenter Manager.

ns8_layout.title: NS8 layout
ns8_layout.description: Menu order Dashboard, Views, Notes, Remotes, Guests, Configuration; Shell and Administration in the top bar.
